name: Tight
notes: Base formation. Line splits are foot-to-foot. Ends are on the line of scrimmage. Wings align one yard outside and one yard behind their end in a two-point stance. FB is four yards deep, directly behind the QB. QB is under center.
coaching_notes: Foot-to-foot splits are the whole point: the defense cannot fit gaps that do not exist.
Both ends must be ON the line. Both wings must be OFF it. Check this every snap in practice or you will get illegal formation flags.
The formation is symmetric, so every play has a left version and a right version with identical rules.
